method: Wall-clock time of the task steps only (login and page set-up excluded), measured with performance.now() inside the Playwright specs: headless Chromium, 1 worker, Vite dev server, local Postgres 17 in Docker, database reseeded before the run. Each task keeps the value from its most recent run; scripted steps, so this is a floor for a human.
machine: Windows_NT 10.0.26300, AMD Ryzen 3 3300X 4-Core Processor x8, 16 GB RAM, Node v24.22.0
